_note: What you see: Empty lists, error messages and public links that no longer work, with the page where they appear, also a filled-in request and the states of Share team folder.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Lege lijsten, foutmeldingen en publieke links die niet meer werken, met de pagina waar ze verschijnen, ook een ingevuld verzoek en de standen van Teammap delen. Onderaan de vijf directe meldingen bij risico: lokgeheim geopend, noodtoegang aangevraagd, geheim mogelijk gecompromitteerd, nieuw apparaat en accountherstel.
12 toestanden zonder eigen bediening, el: 12 states without their own controls, each with the page where they appear
Op /secrets, als zoeken of filteren niet: On /secrets, when search or filter finds nothing
Geen geheim past bij de zoekterm of de f: No secret matches the search term or the filters. Change the search term or the filters.
Verwijderde geheimen blijven hier 30 dag: Deleted secrets stay here for 30 days before Keepiq deletes them permanently.
In de dialoog Labels uit de selectiestro: In the Labels dialog from the selection bar, when saving fails
Kon de labels niet wijzigen. Probeer het: Could not change the labels. Try again.
In de dialoog Vraag om een inloggegeven,: In the Ask for a credential dialog, while no field is chosen
Noodtoegang na een sleutelwissel: Emergency access after a key change
Uw sleutelrotatie heeft de noodtoegang v: Your key rotation removed this contact's emergency access. Appoint them again if you still want to.
Voor dit contact stond een verzoek om no: This contact had an open or already approved emergency access request when you changed your key, so they did not get your new key. Do not appoint them again unless you know the request was genuine.
Op /emergency-access, onder Kluizen die: On /emergency-access, under Vaults you can recover
De sleutel van de verlener is in uw brow: The grantor's key was recovered in your browser. You can now read their vault.
Kan de toegang niet herstellen. De wacht: Cannot recover access. The waiting period has not passed yet or the grantor rejected the request.
Op /share/link, /send en /share/request,: On /share/link, /send and /share/request, without sidebar; seen in the live app
This shared link is not available. It may have expired or been used up.
Deze is vernietigd, verlopen of heeft no: It was destroyed, has expired or never existed.
Op de pagina Geheim invullen, als de lin: On the Fill in secret page, when the request link no longer works.
Op /incoming, zolang niemand bij een par: On /incoming, while nobody at a partner organisation shares anything with you; seen in the live app
Geheimen die mensen in partnerorganisati: Secrets people in partner organisations share with you appear here.
Op /share/request, na Versturen en bij o: On /share/request, after Send and when the same link is opened again; seen in the live app
Thank you, the secret has been delivered.
Wie de link opnieuw opent, ziet alleen d: Whoever opens the link again only sees this notice.
Op /approvals/share of /approvals/group: On /approvals/share or /approvals/group without the token from the notification; seen in the live app
Deze goedkeuringslink is onvolledig. Ope: This approval link is incomplete. Open it again from the notification.
Teammap delen, nog niet gedeeld: Share team folder, not shared yet
In de dialoog Teammap delen (kluismenu,: In the Share team folder dialog (vault menu, Share vault) before the vault is a team folder; seen in the live app
Deel de map \"Koppelingen\" en elk gehei: Share the folder "Koppelingen" and every secret in it with your team. Members receive their own encrypted copies. No unencrypted content ever reaches the server.
In de dialoog Teammap delen, als een geh: In the Share team folder dialog, when a secret in the folder is encrypted with a revoked suite; seen in the live app
De encryptiesuite is ingetrokken. Geheim: The encryption suite has been revoked. Secrets encrypted with a revoked suite cannot be copied to the members.
5 kopieën van een geheim moeten nog word: 5 copies of a secret still need to be encrypted and shared.
Vijf gebeurtenissen geven meteen een Nex: Five events send a Nextcloud notification at once to the people they concern, not in a digest. No notification contains a secret value. Failed unlocks and policy changes reach only the audit trail and the SIEM export.
De applicatie zaaksysteem-api haalde het: The application zaaksysteem-api fetched the decoy Oude VPN-beheerder. This secret should never be used.
zojuist · aan de eigenaar en alle beheer: just now · to the owner and every administrator
Anouk Bakker vraagt noodtoegang tot uw k: Anouk Bakker requests emergency access to your vault. Without your response she gets read access after 7 days.
zojuist · aan u als verlener: just now · to you as grantor
Lars de Koning markeerde Beheeraccount z: Lars de Koning flagged Beheeraccount zaaksysteem as possibly compromised. Rotate the password.
Firefox on Windows (Zuiddrecht, 192.0.2.41) wants to open your vault. If you do not recognise this device, deny.
Sanne Yilmaz heeft een herstelverzoek vo: Sanne Yilmaz filed a recovery request for her account. A second security officer must co-approve it.
zojuist · aan de beveiligingsfunctionari: just now · to the security officers
